stage: PREGENERATION ONLY: no Wan denoising or generated-video result
scope: Two previously seen procedural development scenes; five guide arms per scene; JEPA-only video VAE roundtrips

source_static.scope: Procedural colored-sprite motion and RGB preservation only; not face identity, physics or general perceptual quality
source_static.rgb_error_scale: MSE of saved uint8 RGB divided by 255, averaged over channels and the declared region
source_static.ground_truth_use: Oracle RGB, masks and path are offline scoring inputs only. Motion compensation uses the commanded translation, not a fitted output motion.

detector.method: Source-exact unambiguous color labels; novel colors use nearest source object mean versus distractor/background means, distance<=0.35 and RGB range>=0.15

metric_definitions.source_hole: Source selected mask minus this frame's target mask; empty regions report null
metric_definitions.destination: Entire desired selected-object support, including any overlap with its source
metric_definitions.background: Outside source selection, current target and distractor
metric_definitions.static_background: Outside the union of the full commanded path, source selection and distractor; the same pixels in every frame
metric_definitions.motion_compensated_texture_mse: Generated pixels at source-mask coordinates plus the known integer command, compared to source selected pixels
metric_definitions.temporal_variance: Population variance across all nine frames at each constant-region pixel, then mean over region and RGB
metric_definitions.successive_frame_error_mse: Mean square difference between generated and oracle successive-frame RGB differences on the constant region
metric_definitions.path_lag_counts: Frames 1..8: desired minus observed x projected onto the incoming command direction; >8 px means lagging, <-8 leading, otherwise within half a step. Not an estimated causal delay.
metric_definitions.direction_counts: Steps 0->1 through 7->8; observed x movement projected onto commanded direction; >2 px correct, <-2 reversed, otherwise stationary
metric_definitions.mean_missing_rule: Primary centroid and amplitude errors require all nine detections, otherwise null. The separately named mean_detected_centroid_error_px describes only detected frames. Missing detections never count as zero error.
